page.content:
Abbasid capital that pulled Silk Road and Indian Ocean goods into one court.

How Baghdad connects

  • Location: Overland Silk Road — Abbasid Baghdad pulled overland Khurasan traffic into one capital.
  • Item: Paper — Paper-making took root in the Abbasid world after arriving from the east.

What is Baghdad?

Baghdad, founded in 762, sat on the Tigris as the Abbasid hinge: overland routes from Khurasan and sea goods up from the Gulf met a city hungry for paper, silk, and translation.

Key threads lead to Overland Silk Road and Paper.
